scripts.worker:dev: npm run build && npx wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.pages:deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=loretto --commit-dirty=true
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 execute loretto-db --local --file=worker/migrations/0001_initial_schema.sql --config wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npx wrangler d1 execute loretto-db --remote --file=worker/migrations/0001_initial_schema.sql --config wrangler.toml
